about.title: 25 years of manufacturing, aimed at one goal: fix it for good
text: We bring over 25 years of manufacturing experience to every repair, and our work has earned 10+ awards.
We specialize in machinery, equipment and tooling repair, and we rebuild ball screws made by many manufacturers.
We work with oil and gas, refineries, chemical plants, aerospace, cement mills, rock quarries and food and dairy, within 50 miles of Houston.
